desc: 暖陶石场加逆侧柔轮光，空白票据标签与全空参数栏八镜收口
leaf: 瓶装女性私密护理液（外用冲洗溶液）
name: 暖陶石场私密护理液款

shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼：用暖陶石台上的立瓶加同框素陶肩做静物研究抢点击，把源首屏的花朵、蝴蝶与批文话术全部换成一件可信器物，不喊任何功效。
shots.textZone: top headline line in #4A2233 with one tracked latin sub-rail, plus three empty lozenge tickets low at the right

shots.intent: 承接源页第 2 屏的六枚症状气泡：气泡结构原样保留，但症状词与抑菌止痒断言一律删除，改成八枚留空票据让买家自行代入，产品只以一件小器物落角。
shots.textZone: reversed headline line plus one short blank rail under each of the eight tickets

shots.intent: 把源页缺失的做工证据补上：只交代瓶盖、旋纹、颈环与液面本身这些可信实物结构，不写容量、不写成分，用可见构造替代源页的批文与药房话术。
shots.textZone: three hairline leader rails at the right, brackets only

shots.intent: 承接源页把本品与其他用品并列的暗示结构：改成同一俯视机位下素陶面与瓷托面上的两件同尺度器物对照，只留空栏不下任何结论、不用 VS 章。
shots.textZone: one blank base rail per half

shots.intent: 承接源页两种使用法卡片里那件器物的实物感：以45度掠射微距交代标贴边缘、瓶身弧面与底足圈，把用法说明整块换成可信材质证据，避免任何身体施用暗示。
shots.textZone: three hairline leader rails along the top, brackets only

shots.intent: 承接源页守护主张的场景位：把真人、药房柜台与花卉蝴蝶全删，只留一件器物与两件无牌参照物在暖陶台面上，用低角度静物锚定尺度与生活感。
shots.textZone: one headline line in the upper third plus one short blank rail at the lower right

shots.intent: 承接源页第 3 屏参数表与第 6 屏证书墙：格位与印章框全部留空，信任改由正面反面侧视三视图的可信构造承担，不出示任何证号、批文或证书。
shots.textZone: one section line above the board plus eight empty rails read as bracketed label slots

shots.intent: 收口：暗墨版场把整组收在一句主张与一个空动作位上，替掉源页尾的证书格、二维码与入会角标，不用促销、批文与统计元素逼单。
shots.textZone: lower band, one bracketed line plus one empty action slot

style.backgroundSystem: one continuous talc-dusted matte clay-plaster podium #EFE2D5 rising against a deeper raw-clay backdrop #D3A88C, with one shallow matte porcelain tray #F7F1EA as the only surface the product is ever seated on; pain-point and closing screens swap in a plain deep-ink panel #4A2233 carrying one hairline #C9557B rule. Never a photographed bathroom, bedroom, dressing table, clinic, pharmacy counter or shop shelf, never a laboratory, never tile, marble, wood, linen, towel weave or printed paper grid, never chrome, mirror or liquid metal, never a frosted-glass shelf, never a water, milk or oil surface, no puddle, no splash, no droplet, no wet reflection, no flower, petal, butterfly, cloud, bubble or sparkle, no candy-pink or peach gradient field.
style.direction: quiet warm clay-plaster apothecary still-life commerce for feminine care
style.iconSystem: single-weight #C9557B outlined lozenge tickets, the stadium-shaped apothecary label tag with fully rounded ends, used as the only graphic container and always left empty inside; one hairline #4A2233 leader line, straight or with one elbow, meeting each ticket at a small solid #4A2233 square terminal; the only digits anywhere in the set are sequential index digits inside lozenge tickets on the two-path usage screen and they carry no unit and no measurement. No filled badge, no seal, no shield, no laurel, no leaf, no droplet, no flask, no triangle, no hexagon, no dashed die-cut outline, no disc, no ring, no check mark, no cross, no star, no arrow implying a test result, no gradient or 3D icon.
style.lightingSystem: one soft warm key near 3400K entering from camera-right at a quarter-back angle about 25 degrees above the surface, so every object carries one broad soft rim along its right shoulder and pools one long soft shadow forward toward camera-left; a weak clay bounce from the left only keeps the label face open, never a front fill and never a hard specular streak; macro and seam screens swap the key for one narrow warm band skimming from camera-right along the surface so each thread, seam and label edge catches its own thin highlight while the backdrop falls soft; the light logic is identical across the set, contact shadows are always believable and the product never floats.
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent quiet warm clay-plaster apothecary visual system for feminine-care e-commerce across the entire image set; fixed palette of talc-dusted matte clay-plaster podium #EFE2D5, matte porcelain tray #F7F1EA, raw unglazed clay rim #D3A88C, plain deep-ink panel #4A2233 and one lozenge-ticket accent #C9557B; warm 3400K treatment; one editorial serif family for headline, section line and tracked latin sub-rail, Chinese copy always inside 「」 brackets only, no second type family; background system limited to the clay podium plus the porcelain tray, with a plain #4A2233 panel and one hairline #C9557B rule on the pain-point and closing screens, never a bathroom, clinic, pharmacy counter, dressing table, laboratory or shop shelf, never tile, marble, wood, linen, paper grid, chrome, glass shelf or liquid surface, no petal, flower, butterfly, cloud, bubble, sparkle or candy-pink gradient; lighting system of one soft warm key near 3400K from camera-right at a quarter-back angle about 25 degrees above the surface, one broad soft rim along the right shoulder, one long soft shadow pooled forward to camera-left, a weak clay bounce from the left, no front fill, narrow warm grazing band only on seam and macro screens, always a believable contact shadow and never a floating product; surfaces limited to matte clay plaster, matte porcelain, raw clay and one plain ink board, the bottle rendering true transparency with honest refraction and a visible meniscus; icon system of single-weight #C9557B outlined empty lozenge tickets with one hairline #4A2233 leader line ending in a small solid square terminal, the only digits allowed being sequential index digits carrying no unit on the two-path screen, no seal, shield, leaf, droplet, flask, triangle, hexagon, dashed die-cut outline, disc, check or cross; the bottle keeps its reference silhouette, shoulder, neck, cap form, cap thread, base ring, transparency, fill level and colourway, any sachet, tube or capsule keeps its own seal, foil, crimp and colourway, packaging the reference does not show is never invented, and every label is a blank legible field with no readable lettering or restyled logo; product is always a still-life study seated on the tray or clay rim, never opened toward a body, never applied, never held, human presence is not used at all, no person, face, hand, limb or body shadow and no anatomical illustration or body diagram; no cure, treatment, relief or prevention claim, no symptom word, no bacterial strain or CFU count, no ingredient or percentage, no dosage or frequency advice, no clinical study, no doctor, pharmacy or laboratory endorsement, no registration or licence number, no drug or medical-device classification, no certification or credential tile, no QR code or membership badge, no volume, count or size numeral, no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.

style.presentationRules: the bottle keeps its exact reference silhouette, shoulder curve, neck, cap form, cap thread, base ring, wall thickness, transparency, fill level and colourway; a sachet, tube, blister or capsule shown anywhere keeps its own seal edge, foil, crimp, body profile and colourway, and packaging the reference does not show is never invented; every label, carton face and foil face is rendered as a blank legible field with clean margin bands, correct placement and no readable lettering, mark, number or restyled logo; the product is always a still-life study seated on the tray or the clay rim, never opened toward a body, never applied, never held, never poured; human presence is not used at all, no person, no face, no profile, no hand, no arm, no leg, no torso, no silhouette, no shadow of a person, and no anatomical illustration, body map or diagram of any kind; bottle vertical edges stay strictly vertical and the base never cropped; every claim slot, spec rail and seal frame stays empty.
style.surfaceSystem: talc-dusted matte clay-plaster podium #EFE2D5, one shallow matte porcelain tray #F7F1EA, one raw unglazed clay rim #D3A88C and one plain deep-ink board #4A2233 for the closing screens. The bottle renders true to the reference: real glass or PET transparency with honest refraction through the shoulder and a visible meniscus, a matte or glossy cap exactly as photographed; no marble, wood, tile, paper card, fabric, straw, powder bed, liquid surface or mirror pool.
style.typography: one editorial serif family throughout, used for headline, section lines and the small tracked latin sub-rail alike: a wide-tracked headline set bare in #4A2233 on the clay field or reversed out of a solid #4A2233 plate on the ink screens, one small tracked sub-rail under it; Chinese copy always inside 「」 brackets only and never more than one headline plus two short rails per screen; short lozenge label slots only, no dense body paragraphs, no outlined bubble lettering, no narrow condensed grotesque, no geometric sans, no handwriting, no mixing of two type families.
